scenario_description: The sandbox prevents a component from allocating beyond its memory-plus-swap cgroup.
expected: The preflight observes memory.max=1073741824 and memory.swap.max=0.
The component exits 137 before the deadline and is not mislabeled as a timeout.
The pipeline remains incomplete, the component hash matches, and cleanup is confirmed.
observed: Preflight read memory.max=1073741824 and memory.swap.max=0 from the live cgroup.
The component touching 1.2 GiB exited 137 after 0.730686 seconds, before its deadline, and timed_out remained false.
The pipeline stayed incomplete, the component hash matched, and exact cleanup left no container.
notes: PASS covers one frozen memory-pressure calibration; it is not a general denial-of-service proof.
